== Summary ==
Stephanie Kagehiro at DecipherCon 1999. Crop of [[:File:Christopher and Stephanie Kagehiro DecipherCon 1999.jpg]]. Photo: Decipher. See [[Stephanie Kagehiro]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Decipher thu11 caption names Christopher and Stephanie Kagehiro as "bro' and sis". Stephanie is the young woman in the pair still.
